utterance: Hi Chloe, I'm one of the doctors here. I can see you've come in because of burning when you wee since yesterday, and you think it might be a UTI. Can you tell me a bit more about what's been happening?
reply: It started yesterday morning, so about a day and a half ago. It really stings and burns, especially right at the end, just like my last one. I'm going constantly, like every half hour, and only a little bit comes out so I have to rush. It is a bit cloudy and smells, but I haven't seen any blood.

utterance: Sorry to hear it's so uncomfortable. Have you had any fever, shivers, pain in your back or sides, nausea, or vomiting? And have you noticed any vaginal discharge, itch, or pain with sex?
reply: No fevers or shivers and I feel fine apart from this, with no pain in my back, just a bit of an ache low down in my tummy, and I am eating normally and haven't been sick. I haven't noticed any vaginal discharge or itch, and pain during intercourse has never been a problem.

utterance: You mentioned this feels like your last one. How many urine infections have you had before, when was the last one, and did you need antibiotics? Also, is there any chance you could be pregnant, and when was your last period?
reply: I only had one other UTI about two years ago, and I haven't taken any antibiotics this year. I don't think I'm pregnant, and my last period was about two weeks ago and it was normal.

utterance: Are you currently sexually active, and if so, do you have a regular partner or any new partners recently? Do you use condoms as well as the pill?
reply: Um, yeah, I have a boyfriend and we've been together about a year, just him. I am on the pill and I don't miss it, and we don't use condoms because I'm on the pill.

utterance: Have you or your boyfriend had any genital sores, and has he had any burning or discharge? Also, are you allergic to any antibiotics, and have you tried anything so far for this?
reply: No, nothing like that with sores or discharge, and no, I'm not allergic to anything that I know of.

result: Leucocytes ++, nitrites positive, blood trace, protein trace. hCG not tested.

awards.label: First-line antibiotic: nitrofurantoin 100 mg 6-hourly for 5 days, fosfomycin 3 g once, or trimethoprim 300 mg daily for 3 days

utterance: Your symptoms and the urine test fit a straightforward bladder infection, sometimes called a water infection or cystitis. There is no sign it has gone to your kidneys: you have no fever, you feel well, and your back is not tender. I am prescribing an antibiotic called trimethoprim, one 300 mg tablet once a day for 3 days. Please finish all three tablets even if you feel better sooner. It should not affect your contraceptive pill, so keep taking that as usual. For the sting, you can take paracetamol or ibuprofen as directed on the packet, and drink plenty of water so your urine stays pale. You do not need to come back for another test unless things do not settle. If you are not clearly improving within 48 hours, or if you develop a fever, shivering, pain in your back or side, vomiting, visible blood in the urine, or you feel very unwell, please come back the same day or go to an emergency department. If this keeps coming back, we can look at prevention and check for other causes, including a sexual infection, though that is less likely with a steady partner and this urine result. Do you have any questions about the plan?
reply: That sounds pretty straightforward, I just want to get the script and get back to work if that's all good.
